This pull request appears to contain a **prompt injection / jailbreak attempt** in its description body. The embedded formatted block includes instructions masquerading as a system message that tries to trick an automated agent into echoing a canary token. This is **not** legitimate session-refactoring content.

**Suggested actions:**
- A human reviewer should inspect this PR carefully before any automation runs.
